[[File:Edgeville Home Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Edgeville Home Teleport''' is the [[home teleport]] of the [[Ancient Magicks]]. It provides players with a free [[teleport]] every half an hour to [[Edgeville]]. It takes around 10 seconds to cast the spell, and importantly, this can be interrupted at any time by [[combat]], and only can be cast 10 seconds or more after combat has ended (similar to logging out). The spell may also only be used every 30 minutes: if a player tries to cast it before 30 minutes have elapsed, they are notified with the remaining time in minutes.

This cooldown is shared with that of other home teleports. Switching spell book will not allow you to use a different home teleport spell until 30 minutes has elapsed.

Although you may only switch to [[Ancient Magicks]] on a [[members]]' server, this home teleport spell will work in F2P.

As with all home teleports, the Edgeville Home Teleport default animation can be overridden with an alternative [[Animation overrides#Home Teleport|animation]], if unlocked.
